title: Jensen Huang Pulls Out of ElevenLabs Summit
excerpt: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has withdrawn from the upcoming ElevenLabs Summit amid ongoing controversy surrounding the company.
body_html:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has withdrawn from his scheduled appearance at the ElevenLabs Summit. The cancellation follows a previous decision by the executive to pull out of an Anthropic event.

The recent withdrawals by the Nvidia chief come amid an ongoing controversy involving the company. Further details regarding the nature of the controversy or the specific reasons behind the event cancellations were not provided in the announcement.
